label: Reaper patchwork along every spaced populated descent
definition: SpacedReaperPatchwork R h Concrete k w is ReaperPatchwork restricted to spaced descents: in every history v accessible from w, along every strictly descending sequence c of moments starting at a populated moment whose slots all last at least some fixed positive duration on the clock k, if every two adjacent local Reaper pieces are realized together in some world accessible from v, then some single world accessible from v realizes every piece along c. In ordinary language: co-possible Reaper trios placed back through a metrically infinite past, at least delta apart, can be put together in one possible world.
note: Analyst gluing premise; attribution deferred. OPEN. Weak version of coinitial patchwork in linear time (spacedPatchworkOfCoinitial). Because no world realizes every piece along a descent (GrimReaperPatchwork arrangementImpossible), this typed premise for a given frame is equivalent to 'along every spaced populated descent, adjacent pieces are not all co-possible'; its warrant must come from the general recombination principle it instantiates (the defeasible case of the #367 audit), not from this instance.
